item.description: The Winter Olympics don't always get as much attention as their summer counterparts. item.title: Words You've Been Using Wrong All Your Life
item.description: We avoid using them in academic papers. We send text messages or post on social media, hoping that autocorrect will correctly distinguish which version of the word is intended for the sentence. We mumble them rather than pronouncing them confidently in conversations, hoping the listener won't notice that we're not sure which form of the word is appropriate for the situation.
